wood.note: Wood, hand-authored combos first. Right, the Grove side: a tree, a trunk from the belt forking twice, twigs out to the rim, roots under the belt; combos along the branches and in the forks' pockets. Left, the Vine side: a spiral vine road winding in from the belt, dragonflies and curls round its outside, a piece in its heart, vines hanging under the belt.
